recalled_knowledge.item: Spin-dependent (Sigma', Sigma'') nuclear responses vanish for even-even nuclei; only 129Xe (J=1/2) and 131Xe (J=3/2) contribute
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Fitzpatrick et al. 2013 / Anand et al. 2014

recalled_knowledge.item: Inelastic kinematics: delta_max(E_R) = v sqrt(2 m_N E_R) - m_N E_R/mu; absolute ceiling mu v^2/2
Binomial/Poisson Asimov significance Z^2 = 2 N KL(f1||f2)
Chiral two-body currents reduce 129Xe/131Xe neutron-spin structure factors by ~10-30 % with isotope-dependent q-dependence; absent from one-body WimPyDD responses
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Menendez, Gazit, Schwenk PRD 86 (2012); Klos et al. PRD 88 (2013)

recalled_knowledge.item: Two-body (isoscalar) SI currents add a few-30 % smooth in q
EXO-200 used ~200 kg xenon enriched to 80.6 % 136Xe; KamLAND-Zen ~745 kg at ~91 %; nEXO plans ~5 t at ~90 %
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: EXO-200 JINST 2012; KamLAND-Zen PRL 2023; nEXO pCDR

recalled_knowledge.item: 136Xe-depleted xenon (enrichment tails) has been discussed for future DM TPCs to remove the 136Xe 2nu-beta-beta background
129Xe enriched to ~80-86 % is commercially available in litre quantities for hyperpolarised MRI; no tonne-scale supply
Natural xenon costs a few thousand USD per kg; enriched 136Xe several times more
Gas-centrifuge enrichment separates by mass, so 129Xe cannot be removed while retaining 128Xe/130Xe; heavy-isotope enrichment removes odd isotopes to a few %

failed_or_abandoned: Point shares of dR/dE at exactly 248 keV as the delta-scan observable: 136Xe vanished at every delta because 248 keV sits on its shell-model M node (251 keV); replaced by 225-271 keV window-integrated shares (extra 2688 diff_rate calls).
Asimov N_tot for the idealised even-A mixture (2.2 events) is outside the asymptotic regime; exact binomial (4 events) quoted instead.
Asimov formula raised ZeroDivisionError for pairs of pure spin operators (identical composition response); guarded with N = infinity, which is the physical answer.
